name: Pinos Genil (Spain)
description: Light green field with a blue wavy fess across the centre, charged with the municipal arms of Pinos Genil outlined in white.
history: Pinos Genil adopted its arms and flag officially on 2 March 2021; the flag is of 3:2, divided into three horizontal stripes, the upper and lower green and the central wavy, with the municipal arms outlined in white at the centre, two thirds of the width in height.

features.role: Pinos Genil arms — outlined in white
